notes:
Did: components/preparation/briefing-block.tsx, the 'Next' card (accent-softer, 3px accent bar) under Sources on the preparation page. It loads prep_get_briefing, reloads on 'preparation-updated' (listen promise has .catch, unlisten on unmount), and keeps a hidden ProviderBoundary for the Summary route. Idle shows the RunNotice ('Uses your Summary model · Remote · openrouter.ai') next to Prepare before anything runs; Prepare re-validates the route (validate_provider_route) and only then calls prep_generate; a route that fails validation blocks Prepare and sends nothing. States: preparing (spinner, 'Preparing the brief… · <Local|LAN|Remote> · <origin>' from the run, Stop -> prep_cancel, disabled while stopping, reload after; a rejection toasts "Couldn't stop preparing. Try again."), failed (PREP_MODEL_FAILED / PREP_PARSE_FAILED / generic copy + Try again), cancelled ('Stopped. Nothing was saved.'), stale run (SELECTION_CHANGED copy), and a stale brief (briefing.stale: 'Some sources changed since this brief was prepared.'). A stored brief still shows under a failed/cancelled/stale run. brief-contents.tsx renders statements, then a mint 'Worth asking' card with questions and rationales; every line has a source chip: document -> onOpenSource({versionId, locator {start,end} from locatorJson}) into the existing SourceViewer; knowledge -> getMeetingKnowledge, claim evidence -> TranscriptDrawer mounted on the preparation page (opening one closes the other); source_unavailable shows a static 'Source deleted' tag; a stale claim gets an amber glyph and sr-only '(changed since this brief)'. Provenance line: 'Prepared from your purpose, <doc titles> and N past-meeting items · Sep 27, 09:11 · K left out' (included and truncated manifest entries count as used). Chip labels come from documents_get_version per distinct manifest version (max 12) and api_get_meetings. highlightFor and claimLinks moved to living-doc/transcript-drawer.tsx (callers in meeting-page, side-peek, source-chip, evidence-popover, history-popover updated) so the preparation page does not import meeting-page; run-notice LOCATION and knowledge-picker shortDate are now exported and reused. Tests: 11 in tests/components/briefing-block.test.tsx, +1 in preparation-page.test (chip -> SourceViewer target with locator). Gallery: preparation-brief-idle (remote route), -preparing, -ready (4 statements, 3 questions), -failed, -stale, 1100x1500 viewport, checked light and dark. base-ipc stubs prep_get_briefing {run:null, briefing:null}.
